dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular closed-loop (O-shaped) and semi-closed (C-shaped) structures visible along the dorsal-lateral midline. Perimeters exhibit a diffuse gradient transition from a dark charcoal exterior to a high-intensity light grey interior. Three prominent rings in the mid-dorsal region show scalloped, non-linear edge boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, high-frequency white pixel clusters concentrated in the cranial and neck regions. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as solid, high-contrast speckles. Lower density of similar high-intensity blobs occurs along the ventral-lateral margin.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest mid-dorsal macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary geometric relationship is formed by a linear chain of four smaller, high-contrast blobs trailing from the mid-dorsal cluster toward the posterior third of the subject.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, high-saturation localized chromatic anomaly (orange-red hue) is visible on the distal edge of the posterior-ventral extremity.
other_distinctive_markers: The facial region displays a high-contrast 'leopard' texture transition where small-diameter circular motifs merge into the larger macro-annuli of the main dorsal-lateral surface.
